segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are overwhelmingly positive, describing dramatic relief from flakiness and parched skin, a plumper and smoother texture, and a 'glass skin' glow; the only dissent is from one reviewer who found the hydration insufficient on its own and still needed to layer a cream or serum on top.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin are split: one calls it 'oily skin approved' since it hydrates without feeling heavy, while another says it makes her skin too greasy and slippery and now only uses it at night, and a third notes it can feel slightly sticky but not enough to bother her.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin have mixed results: one with an oily T-zone felt the product just sat on the surface without deep hydration and worried it was too rich, and another found the hydration insufficient and the pads drying out faster than expected, while a third was happy overall but noticed slight excess richness around her nose.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are mostly positive, reporting no irritation, redness, or tingling even with regular use; dissent includes one reviewer whose already redness- and tingling-prone sensitive skin felt even more irritated after use, and another who experienced occasional itchiness.

concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, especially those with dry skin, describe strong, lasting hydration and relief from flakiness or parched skin; a notable minority, however, say the hydrating effect is only average, sits on the surface without penetrating deeply, or even left their face feeling drier afterward.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report the pads calm redness and post-cleansing burning, including several who specifically sought relief from a hot, reactive complexion; one reviewer, however, says her already redness-prone sensitive skin felt more irritated after use.
concerns.barrier: The one reviewer who mentions her skin barrier directly says it healed quickly with regular use.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers, including ones prone to severe or hormonal acne, report fewer breakouts and blemishes with regular use; dissent includes two reviewers who developed new blemishes, one of whom broke out for the first week before it settled down, and another who suspected the formula was too rich for her skin.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers say the pads hydrate without adding grease and even help control excess oil; dissent comes from a couple of reviewers with oily skin who found it too greasy or slightly sticky on their skin specifically.

extraits.titre: The pads are gentle and don't...
extraits.texte: The pads are gentle and don't irritate my skin, which I really appreciate. There's nothing particularly great or terrible about this product. I have combination skin with a slightly oily T­zone, and even when I leave it on like a mask, I don't feel like it's deeply hydrating. Instead, it seems to just sit on the surface of my skin. If anything, it feels like there might be too many nutrients, potentially causing blemishes. I wonder if it would be better to keep it in the fridge, but I haven't tried that yet.

extraits.titre: The texture of these pads is...
extraits.texte: The texture of these pads is really pleasant! I also love that the scent isn't irritating at all. I don't think these pads agree with my skin! After using them, I noticed tiny blemishes popping up and my skin actually felt even drier.

extraits.titre: The pads are thin and adhere...
extraits.texte: The pads are thin and adhere well to the skin. They provide a refreshing hydration that's great for cooling down your face when it feels hot. Perfect for when you want to replenish moisture. I often use them on busy mornings or when I'm too lazy for a full mask routine ­ just 5­10 minutes on the skin does the trick. The essence seems quite generous. The pads themselves are gentle and non­irritating. Personally, I appreciated that the scent wasn't too strong. I'd recommend these for combination dehydrated skin types and those experiencing deep dryness. You can't carry them around as the essence leaks if the container tips over or flips. The tweezers are difficult to use and inconvenient. As someone with super sensitive skin that's always prone to redness and tingling, using these made my skin feel even more irritated. The pads are tough and don't tear easily, making them difficult to apply to smaller areas of the face. It's great to keep these in the refrigerator before use.

extraits.titre: As someone with dry skin, I...
extraits.texte: As someone with dry skin, I often experience makeup looking a bit patchy and feeling dry underneath. So I decided to give this product a try, and wow... it's legendary! I had high expectations given its popularity, but it exceeded them!!! The pads are thin, so they don't fall off easily when applied. Despite being thin, they maintain a long­lasting, hydrating effect, so I don't feel like I'm wasting them each time I use one! As soon as I put it on, I felt the heat in my skin subside and an immediate boost of hydration!! When used before makeup, it creates a beautifully smooth canvas for foundation. While my skin is usually fine, I tend to experience redness and a burning sensation after cleansing. Applying this pad then gives an instant cooling effect, which I love! The thinness allows for excellent adherence, and my skin feels incredibly moisturized even after removing it! If you're dealing with deep dryness and looking for a hydrating pad, I highly recommend this one. While using the tweezers is fine, it's a bit inconvenient to put the pads back in the container after use.

A soothing hydration toner pad that even super sensitive skin can use without worry. The toner has a pleasant scent and gives a beautiful glow as if you've layered hydrating toner multiple times, while addressing deep dryness. The pads are incredibly soft on the skin without any roughness, making them highly recommended for sensitive skin types looking to even out their complexion. I've used 3 bottles and never experienced redness, tingling, or itching. Refills are available at a reasonable price, and during sales, you can get 100 pads for around $17, which is quite good. It absorbs well without stickiness, leaving the skin moisturized. Recommended for dry, sensitive, combination, and oily skin types. Not recommended for extremely dry or extremely oily skin. While it does address deep dryness, as someone with dry skin, I found it a bit insufficient on its own. Layering with a cream or serum is necessary. Although the essence is generously applied to the pads, when you stick them on and let them dry, they tend to dry out oddly and start to peel off. Also, the initial seal on the lid was so tight that it was difficult to open even with a cutter. Once opened, you need to apply significant force, which can easily lead to spills. Despite these issues, I'm very satisfied with the product itself and would recommend it! I have combination to sensitive skin, and I noticed a slight richness on my nose area. The hydration is top­notch! When I use it as a mask in the evening to refine my skin texture, I wake up with amazing moisture levels. I'm prone to severe acne, but since using this, my blemishes and pimples have significantly decreased. It's also great for makeup application in the morning ­ everything just glides on! On busy mornings, this is all you need. No need for toner and emulsion ­ this does it all! It provides deep hydration, and I'm already on my third bottle. Plus, it's such great value for the size. Definitely worth buying! If you have oily skin, you might want to try something else. As someone with oily skin, I find it makes my skin too greasy. It provides so much hydration that it actually makes my skin feel slippery. I only use it at night now. It's great as a nighttime mask, and it works wonderfully as a base for makeup in the morning too! Make sure to apply it generously on problem areas before going to bed.

Skin type: Extremely dry, sensitive, and prone to blemishes As someone with extremely dry skin and severe deep dryness, I found that Water Mide works great as a toner pad. After cleansing, I use it as a toner pad to even out my skin texture. When I place it on my cheeks and forehead, my skin feels incredibly smooth! I didn't experience any blemishes, so I've already used up two bottles. Since it's a toner pad, the pads are a bit thin, so I wouldn't recommend them for exfoliating or refining skin texture.
